brief.headline: Priority alert: possible concealment in clothing on the aisle camera.
observed: At 2.8 s: An item was taken from the shelf.
At 4.0 s: Item in the left hand was last seen at the waist; no basket, shelf or scan event explains it.
At 6.4 s: Item in the left hand was last seen away from the body; no basket, shelf or scan event explains it.
Hand at waist was 0.12; the typical value for normal clips on this camera is 0 (range 0 to 0.16).
Unaccounted items was 2; the typical value for normal clips on this camera is 0 (range -6 to 1).
benign_explanations: The shopper is carrying the item against their body because they have no basket.
The hand went to a pocket for a phone or keys and the item detector lost the product.
The camera view was blocked by another shopper at the key moment.
brief.recommended_action: Send a colleague to greet the shopper and offer a basket. Do not stop or search. Review the footage in full before any further step.
brief.confidence_note: Model risk is 1.00, which is strong evidence for this scenario. Pose tracking was clear throughout the clip.
